mentions.name: Mecha Comet
mentions.description: Mecha Comet is a modular handheld Linux computer, with attention to clearly communicating its use cases and providing a good developer experience for hackers regardless of hardware background.
mentions.problem: Explaining the device's different use-cases and possibilities in a clear way, and handling developer experience for any hacker who comes across the device with or without hardware experience.
mentions.audience: Hackers with or without hardware experience
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on the Mecha Comet (https://mecha.so/comet), a modular handheld Linux computer.
